issue_request: FHIR-31863 was Published and resolved Not Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked to collapse the R4 medicinal product, pharmaceutical, packaged, and manufactured resources into one resource because the resource boundaries were not justified.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly tagged FHIR-31863 was found. The current source already includes the R5 renamed resources and substantial module/resource guidance explaining the product/package/item model, simpler one-resource use, contained-resource options, and distinct resource responsibilities. Related commits for FHIR#31544 and FHIR#31805 appear to be the documentation path that applied the improved guidance.
additional_context: The active current-build resources are MedicinalProductDefinition, PackagedProductDefinition, ManufacturedItemDefinition, and AdministrableProductDefinition. FHIR-28581 is the same change family and was also Published/Not Persuasive with Modification after asking to reduce product-definition resource types. BRR minutes for 2022-03-03 list FHIR-31863 and FHIR-28581 as remaining in-person negatives. Current PackagedProductDefinition source and examples use packageFor, so productFor was stale in the narrative guidance.
reconciliation: Changed MedicinalProductDefinition and PackagedProductDefinition Scope and Usage text so package linkage is described as PackagedProductDefinition.packageFor/packageFor instead of the nonexistent productFor relationship.
